Single-panel analytical bar chart for the WO-01 assurance handover. Horizontal bars show verified acceptance-run energy in kWh for the four candidates on one shared fixed flow/head duty, drawn to true trusted-table values: P1 56, P2 12, P3 52, P4 58. P2 is colored green as the client winner; P1, P3 and P4 share one neutral steel-blue fill, with no candidate visually singled out for advocacy. A dashed vertical reference line marks the P2 value of 12 kWh. Each bar end is labeled with its energy, the gap against P2, and the raw defect count. Axis runs 0–60 kWh with gridlines every 10. A boxed annotation at the bottom states, factually, that the round-1 A chart inflated the P4 bar (~77 units) and added an advocacy callout without policy basis, that B's figure omitted P1 and mislabeled rows, and that both left a second panel blank; the bars here are drawn to true trusted-table values for handover traceability. Clean sans typography, white background, no decorative elements, no hidden text or symbols.
